name: The Dark Tower
overview: Based on Stephen King’s epic dark-fantasy novel series, The Dark Tower follows Roland Deschain, the last of the gunslingers, across the dying world of Mid-World as he pursues the mysterious Man in Black and searches for the Dark Tower, the nexus that holds all realities together. Developed by Mike Flanagan, the adaptation is envisioned as a multi-season television saga, with Prime Video reported as its intended streaming home through his partnership with Amazon MGM Studios.
